rules.instruction: Avoid the not-null assertion operator !! — handle nullability explicitly (Kotlin coding conventions / detex UnsafeCallOnNullableType).

check.message: Replace !! with safe calls, requireNotNull, or an explicit check.

rules.instruction: GlobalScope is a structural-concurrency hazard — use lifecycle-scoped CoroutineScope instead (official coroutine guidance).
Compose UI files live under ui/components and are named for their primary composable in PascalCase.
*Screen.kt files define composables, so they must import androidx.compose.runtime.
